title: Max-retry exhaustion behavior
description: Implement max-retry exhaustion behavior. Acceptance: correctly handles case when all retries exhausted, reports failure appropriately.
notes: Implemented bounded max-retry terminal behavior in generic Zephyr/C SCHC. Sender terminal cleanup now clears retransmission cursor state while preserving the one queued Sender-Abort; short output leaves that abort/state/output atomic, and all late ACKs/timeouts cannot reverse terminal status or emit another abort. Receiver now retains a bounded terminal latch after inbound or emitted abort, rejects late fragments/ACK-REQs without state mutation, and requires explicit release/re-init before a new T=0 context. Fixed one-octet input to return TOO_SHORT before decoder access. Focused tests cover exact initial-All1-plus-three-retry threshold, fifth-event abort, short-buffer atomicity, late input, explicit release, and canonical control bytes. Corrected stale schc_generic assertions: sender retry uses the canonical one-tile/window-0 scenario; truncated input expects TOO_SHORT; RCS-failure vector retransmits its specified All-1 rather than falsely expecting abort. Validation: AppleClang strict host UBSan schc_ack_processing 1/1 pass; schc_reassembly 1/1 pass; Python retry/vector consumers 4 pass (764 deselected); Rust lichen-schc fragmentation_vectors with std+raw-fragment-codec 2/2 pass in isolated target; Zephyr 4.1 nRF52840 cross-build passes (FLASH 139593 B, RAM 31872 B); Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 schc_generic runtime reports 10/10 and PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL (bounded timeout terminated QEMU after suite output); git diff --check passes. No live path collision.
close_reason: Implemented and validated exact max-retry exhaustion, one-shot terminal abort, bounded receiver tombstone, late-input rejection, and atomic error behavior across C/Python/Rust/Zephyr gates.
